captions.detailed: This 3D model is a hard hat clip designed to hold a cylindrical object like a flashlight. It consists of a large, C-shaped open collar on one side and a flat, angled insertion tongue with a locking barb on the other. The collar features outward-flared tabs at its opening to guide the flashlight during insertion, while the locking tongue is reinforced with a small fillet brace to ensure stability when clipped into an accessory slot.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric hard hat flashlight clip in OpenSCAD. The design must feature an open C-clamp collar for holding the flashlight and an angled locking tongue with a barb for securing it into a hard hat slot. Key parameters should include clip_width, diam (flashlight diameter), thickness, locking_clip_angle, locking_clip_reach, and locking_clip_barb_size.
captions.factory: The model is built in 2D and then extruded to the desired height using linear_extrude(height=clip_width). The 2D profile is created by unioning a C-clamp base with two insertion tab modules (drawn using polygon and trimmed with a difference of circle shapes) and a fillet brace (using rotate and square). The locking tongue is constructed using two segments: a straight rectangular arm (square) and an angled arm (rotate, square) that terminates with a triangular locking barb (polygon).
